workflow.title: Route leads by region and log assignments
workflow.goal: Read the leads sheet, skip spam, assign west coast leads to Ellen, east coast leads to Rajesh and all other leads to Sarah, append one row per routed lead to lead-log, and send Tom a notification for each routed lead whose budget is above 25000.

assumptions: Spam leads (status = spam) are not routed.
West coast = region values west, west coast or pacific; east coast = region values east, east coast, northeast, southeast or atlantic (matched ignoring case). Everything else goes to Sarah.
'cc me' is implemented as a separate notification e-mail to Tom for each routed lead with budget above 25000, because outbox.send has no cc field.
assignedAt is not written per row because rule and select set values are constant; the log has no timestamp per row.
risks: Region labels that do not match the listed values fall through to Sarah.
Each notification to Tom is a live outbound e-mail and asks a person before dispatch.
The lead-log timestamp column is not populated.
successCriteria: Every non-spam lead is assigned to exactly one of Ellen, Rajesh or Sarah.
One lead-log row is appended per routed lead and the audit of the sheet passes.
Each lead with budget above 25000 produces one notification to Tom.

nodes.description: Keep leads that are not spam.
